body:
C33 THE BOUT THAT WAS NOT WATCHED ON A CARD is yours: research/TASK_C33.md. Sonnet, effort high, Fast off. Engine only, one region.

The gap: only record_watched_world_bout (GameState.gd:2391) ever writes a history row's bout_read key. Every bout settled through _apply_fight_result (:10414, row built :10711) - Grand Prix, Contender Series, promotion, any ordinary offer settled at the weekly rollover - carries none, so get_bout_read answers ABSENT forever while the evidence sat in pending_fight_result and was dropped. R49 (589dd30) just froze decision_type and scoring_style beside method and scorecards, so the fix is faithful rather than reconstructed.

Two rules are the point. RANGE IS ABSENT and must say so: the aggregate comes from fight_state["log"], which dies with the ring, so store range = {"source": SOURCE_ABSENT} and never synthesise one from the cards. And NO BACKFILL: a row already on disk stays absent, as get_bout_read's docstring already promises.

You own GameState.gd, BoutRead.gd and bout_read_test.gd. ScheduleHubPanel.gd and OfficeHubPanel.gd are mine this cycle (R50) - do not open them. Do not edit HANDOFF.md; send me one line when it lands and I convert the block.
